mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contruction ( contruction_id, user_id, user_name, contruction_name, address, phone_number, zip_code, mail, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{contructionId}, #{userID}, #{userName}, #{contructionName}, #{address}, #{phoneNumber}, #{zipCode}, #{mail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO contruction ( contruction_id, user_id, user_name, contruction_name, address, phone_number, zip_code, mail ) VALUES
( #{item.contructionId}, #{item.userID}, #{item.userName}, #{item.contructionName}, #{item.address}, #{item.phoneNumber}, #{item.zipCode}, #{item.mail} )
mapper.select: SELECT C.contruction_id AS contructionId, C.user_id AS userID, C.user_name AS userName, C.contruction_name AS contructionName, C.address, C.phone_number AS phoneNumber, C.zip_code AS zipCode, C.mail, C.created_at AS createdAt, C.updated_at AS updatedAt, f.uuid AS fileUuId, f.contruction_id AS fileContructionId, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_path AS filePath, f.create_time AS fileCreateTime FROM ( SELECT contruction_id, user_id, user_name, contruction_name, address, phone_number, zip_code, mail, created_at, updated_at FROM contruction ORDER BY contruction_name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) c LEFT JOIN files f ON c.contruction_id = f.contruction_id ORDER BY c.contruction_name;

SELECT c.contruction_id AS contructionId, c.user_id AS userID, c.user_name AS userName, c.contruction_name AS contructionName, c.address, c.phone_number AS phoneNumber, c.zip_code AS zipCode, c.mail, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, f.uuid AS fileUuId, f.contruction_id AS fileContructionId, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_path AS filePath, f.create_time AS fileCreateTime FROM contruction c LEFT JOIN files f ON c.contruction_id = f.contruction_id WHERE c.contruction_id = #{contructionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE contruction SET user_id = #{userID}, user_name = #{userName}, contruction_name = #{contructionName}, address = #{address}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, mail = #{mail}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE contruction_id = #{contructionId} AND updated_at = #{updatedAt}
